about: fk-domains' application mutants (plan §20.6); each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fd1-offset-twice
mutants.to:
let skip = if from+from < to { from + from } else { to }
	for t in domains.Catalog[skip:to] {
mutants.rule: A page is the items offset to offset+limit of the whole answer (law PageIsSliceOfWhole).

mutants.name: fd1-featured-out-of-order
mutants.rule: The featured TLDs come first in the original's order (WireAgreesWithOrigin, case search-top).

mutants.name: fd1-1024-refused
mutants.rule: A body of 1,024 bytes is answered (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 19-exactly-1024).

mutants.name: fd1-no-store-missing
mutants.rule: Every answer of the endpoint carries Cache-Control: no-store (WireAgreesWithOrigin).

mutants.name: fd1-upper-label
mutants.rule: An upper-case label does not decode (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 11-upper; case not-a-label).

mutants.name: fd1-zero-limit
mutants.from: type Limit int where 1 <= it && it <= 556
mutants.to: type Limit int where 0 <= it && it <= 556
mutants.rule: A limit of 0 does not decode (WireAgreesWithOrigin, 14-zero-limit).
